name: blockletter-monorepo
description: Block-based email newsletter builder: a typed document model, an email-safe renderer, and an accessible React editor.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/react --if-present && npm run build -w apps/playground --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:denylist
